subject: literacy
concept: Using Greek and Latin roots to unlock the meaning of academic vocabulary
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading morphology sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student matches root-word tiles (e.g. 'bio', 'graph') to their core meanings using physical cards
exercise.pictorial: Student matches words built from a shared root to a picture representing that root's meaning
exercise.abstract: Student defines an unfamiliar academic word using a known Greek or Latin root

misconception_flags: memorizes individual whole words without connecting them to the shared root's meaning

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
